name: Xenobot Kinematics Simulator (Gillespie Engine)
description: Simulates xenobot locomotion using a two-layer coupled model. Layer 1 runs the Gillespie Stochastic Simulation Algorithm (SSA) to model enzyme production inside each motor cell, where the promoter strength (J23100/J23106/J23114 from the Anderson J23 series) determines the synthesis rate k_synth and thus the mean enzyme count ⟨E⟩. Layer 2 uses the derived motor force (proportional to ⟨E⟩) as the input to a 2D Euler kinematic integrator to produce a trajectory. Both the biochemical time-course (enzyme + ATP traces) and the physical trajectory are plotted and saved. This replaces the v1 hardcoded motor vectors with biochemistry-derived forces, closing the design gap between promoter selection and macroscale locomotion.

inputs.name: cells
inputs.description: List of cell configuration dicts. Each must contain 'promoter' (str): one of 'J23100' (High, k_synth=2.5), 'J23106' (Medium, k_synth=1.175), 'J23114' (Low, k_synth=0.25), or 'custom'. Optional fields: 'direction_x' (float, default 1.0), 'direction_y' (float, default 0.0), 'label' (str), 'k_synth' (float, only used when promoter='custom').

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: Number of kinematic Euler integration steps. Defaults to 50.

inputs.name: noise
inputs.description: Gaussian noise standard deviation (µm/step) added to each cell at each kinematic step. Defaults to 0.05.

inputs.name: gillespie_t_end
inputs.description: Duration of the biochemical Gillespie simulation in milliseconds. Longer duration allows more enzyme accumulation. Defaults to 10.0.

inputs.name: base_motor
inputs.description: Maximum motor force in µm/step, achieved when ⟨E⟩ ≥ E_ref (20 molecules). Actual force = min(base_motor, base_motor × ⟨E⟩/20). Defaults to 2.0.

inputs.name: atp_init
inputs.description: Initial number of ATP substrate molecules available to each cell. Models metabolic load — lower values limit catalytic activity. Defaults to 500.

outputs.description: A dictionary with a 'content' key containing one text block: a summary string reporting promoter identities, k_synth values, mean enzyme counts ⟨E⟩, ATP depletion, derived motor forces, net motor vector, net displacement, and the path to the saved PNG plot (dual-panel: trajectory + per-cell biochemical traces).
